ideas.title: The Fallout of Feeding Our Future Fraud Case
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the Feeding Our Future fraud case on Minnesota communities and the non-profit sector.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the financial transactions leading to the fraud.
questions: How did the fraud go undetected for so long?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover systemic issues in non-profit oversight and the impact on Minnesota communities.

ideas.title: Kash Patel's Alleged $1M FBI Bonus Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations against Kash Patel and the implications for FBI accountability.
ideas.angle: Examine the evidence and potential motivations behind the allegations.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged scheme?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on potential misconduct within the FBI and the need for greater oversight.
